source: src/data/meta.json -> remembrances (rewards, journey selections, duplication assignments, duplication class, completion protection); src/data/route.full.json -> steps (boss kill step that drops each remembrance, and its area); src/data/bosses.full.json -> encounters (area fallback only).
method: Entries follow the user's duplication-priority order (most likely to need a second reward first). Each entry is resolved from meta.json remembrances by id: rewards, Journey 1/Journey 2 selections, and duplication assignments are copied verbatim; the duplicatePlan text states which reward to take first and which duplicate site to use. routeStepIds are the route.full.json steps whose instruction names that remembrance (the boss kill that drops it); area is that step's area. counts.duplicateNow = entries whose meta journey1Duplication is an assigned J1 DUP site; counts.noDuplicate = entries whose duplicateTarget states no duplicate copy is needed and that have no J1 assignment; counts.defer = the remaining entries, whose second reward waits for Journey 2 with the duplicate held in reserve. rewards lists the Journey 1 selection first, then the remaining unique rewards, in meta.json order. Heart of Bayle (user priority 26) is not a remembrance: the Heart is a non-duplicable exchange input documented in branch-plan.json, so it does not appear here. Remembrances are never consumed for runes before both rewards are secured.
